title: Kitchenaid — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Kitchenaid.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Marks the Spot." Premium tier. KitchenAid was born in 1919 with the stand mixer and has carried that cooking-first DNA into every major appliance category. The brand occupies the sweet spot between mass-market and luxury — professional-inspired design with Even-Heat True Convection, chrome-infused griddles, and PrintShield finish that resists fingerprints and smudges. The FreeFlex third rack on dishwashers is the most flexible in the market.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Home cooks who care about food. Customers stepping up from Whirlpool/Maytag who want a premium feel without luxury pricing. Kitchen remodels that want a cohesive look.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Kitchenaid:

• FreeFlex third rack in dishwashers — deepest, most adjustable third rack available

• Even-Heat True Convection with bow-tie shaped element for consistent baking results

• PrintShield finish resists fingerprints AND smudges — stainless without the maintenance

• Chrome-Infused Griddle on ranges — restaurant-grade surface for pancakes and more

• Same Whirlpool Corp reliability but with premium design and cooking performance
